validation.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=/dev/shm .venv/bin/python -m pytest sw/tests/test_pcie_clocked_bank_v3.py sw/tests/test_pcie_clock_vco_layout.py sw/tests/test_pcie_sampler_layout.py sw/tests/test_pcie_rx_cell.py sw/tests/test_pcie_analog_bank.py -q -p no:cacheprovider

reproduction.parents: Both exact parent generated GDS/LEF/SPICE/result files included under parents/. Their transitive pinned source/runtime/PDK paths must be present; original source methods and circuits are also included. No old producer is modified.

render.method: Native KLayout LayoutView load original GDS, original PDK layer properties, full hierarchy and save_image. Only grid/text visibility altered; no generated illustration.

retention: All final native physical views, complete positive/negative logs and databases, generated fault inputs and exact project source copies retained. No vendor runtime or implementation source redistributed.
limitations: The fixed VCO drives four differential sampler clock branches by real metal. Native connectivity/DRC does not prove electrical fanout, input common-mode compatibility, extracted parasitics, current density, clock skew/jitter or post-layout 8GHz performance. The original VCO has independent real corner headroom failures. No PLL locking or clock/data recovery and no main-chip integration is claimed.
